events.line: Axis Bank will trim the benefits on its premium Magnus for Burgundy credit card from 28 August. The bank will increase the Dynamic Currency Conversion (DCC) markup from 1.5 percent to 2 percent, discontinue reward points on toll-related transactions and gift card purchases, and revise the way domestic airport lounge access works through Priority Pass.

events.line: Several banks are set to revise select service charges from August 1. Ujjivan Small Finance Bank has announced a revised SMS alert fee of Rs 0.30 per message, subject to a specified monthly cap. Customers should also check with their respective banks for any changes to debit card annual maintenance charges, transaction fees, or other banking service charges that may take effect during the month.
